question: Give me each airport and how many other airports are within 500 km of it, showing the top 20 busiest neighborhoods.
sql: WITH t AS (SELECT name,type,ST_Transform(geometry,'EPSG:4326','EPSG:3857',always_xy:=true) AS geom_m FROM airports) SELECT a.name,a.type,COUNT(b.name) AS airports_within_500km FROM t a JOIN t b ON a.name<>b.name AND ST_DWithin(a.geom_m,b.geom_m,500000) GROUP BY a.name,a.type ORDER BY airports_within_500km DESC LIMIT 20

question: List the major airports that have at least five other airports within 300 km.
sql: WITH t AS (SELECT name,type,ST_Transform(geometry,'EPSG:4326','EPSG:3857',always_xy:=true) AS geom_m FROM airports) SELECT a.name,a.type,COUNT(b.name) AS nearby_count FROM t a JOIN t b ON a.name<>b.name AND ST_DWithin(a.geom_m,b.geom_m,300000) WHERE a.type LIKE '%major%' GROUP BY a.name,a.type HAVING COUNT(b.name)>=5 ORDER BY nearby_count DESC

question: Compare the average number of neighboring airports within 200 km for mid versus major airports.
sql: WITH t AS (SELECT name,type,ST_Transform(geometry,'EPSG:4326','EPSG:3857',always_xy:=true) AS geom_m FROM airports),counts AS (SELECT a.name,a.type,COUNT(b.name) AS nearby_200km FROM t a JOIN t b ON a.name<>b.name AND ST_DWithin(a.geom_m,b.geom_m,200000) GROUP BY a.name,a.type) SELECT CASE WHEN type LIKE '%mid%' AND type NOT LIKE '%major%' THEN 'mid' WHEN type LIKE '%major%' THEN 'major' ELSE 'other' END AS category,AVG(nearby_200km) AS avg_neighbors_200km,COUNT(*) AS airport_count FROM counts WHERE type LIKE '%mid%' OR type LIKE '%major%' GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

question: Map the airport clusters formed with a 250 km neighborhood and at least three airports per cluster, returning the cluster centroid as GeoJSON.
sql: WITH t AS (SELECT name,ST_Transform(geometry,'EPSG:4326','EPSG:3857',always_xy:=true) AS geom_m FROM airports),clustered AS (SELECT name,geom_m,ST_ClusterDBSCAN(geom_m,250000,3) OVER () AS cluster_id FROM t) SELECT cluster_id,COUNT(*) AS airport_count,ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_Centroid(ST_Collect(geom_m))) AS centroid_geojson FROM clustered WHERE cluster_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cluster_id ORDER BY airport_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: Give me the number of airports in each 10-degree latitude/longitude grid cell that contains at least one airport, with the cell geometry as GeoJSON.
sql: WITH grid AS (SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(lon,lat,lon+10,lat+10,4326) AS geom FROM generate_series(-180,170,10) AS lon(lon) CROSS JOIN generate_series(-60,70,10) AS lat(lat)) SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(g.geom) AS cell_geojson,COUNT(a.name) AS airport_count FROM grid g LEFT JOIN airports a ON ST_Within(a.geometry,g.geom) GROUP BY g.geom HAVING COUNT(a.name)>0 ORDER BY airport_count DESC

question: List the least important airports with scalerank 9 that are isolated, meaning no other airport within 500 km.
sql: WITH t AS (SELECT name,scalerank,ST_Transform(geometry,'EPSG:4326','EPSG:3857',always_xy:=true) AS geom_m FROM airports WHERE scalerank=9) SELECT a.name,a.scalerank FROM t a LEFT JOIN t b ON a.name<>b.name AND ST_DWithin(a.geom_m,b.geom_m,500000) WHERE b.name IS NULL ORDER BY a.name
